cases.purpose: A paused seeded game ignores movement, rotation and drop; it resumes gravity and quits with the score and terminal restored.

cases.oracle: A gravity control precedes pause; the decoded four-cell board remains identical through j, k, l, space and a delay, then gravity resumes after p. Quit must report the score and restore termios and cursor.
cases.comparison: Records input bytes, timestamps, decoded cell positions, raw output, exit status and terminal state.
